name: Hero Starcall adds its tooltip spell power and attack power to the Arcane hit (#6990)
contract: Starcall 289250 tooltip (Spell.dbc Description[enUS]): 'Smash up to $i enemies, dealing
${$m1+$spa*0.3+$AP*0.15+0} Arcane damage'. Effect0 is SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE with BasePoints 1 and
DieSides 1, so without the 30% Arcane spell power and 15% attack power terms a hit deals 2 damage. With a
1000 spell power and 1000 attack power fixture each hit promises at least 2 + 300 + 150 = 452 before
mitigation; the assertion leaves room for partial resists and still separates the reported ~2 damage hit.
